text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the photoshoot of Victoire Pisa in her Racewear for a special feature article.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break from shooting on location in the city,
I sat catching my breath on a nearby bench, when...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
......*sniff*, *hic*...!
...Mama... where are you...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Could it be
that you've been separated from your mother?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Let's look for it together.
Come on... don't cry anymore, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: ! ...Really...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
...Excuse me, Trainer.
Could I have a moment of your time?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we still have time before the shoot, so it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Did you get separated
from your mother around here?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
...I wonder if Mom can find us...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we will find it.
Please leave it to us.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Is anyone looking for a lost child~!
choice_data_list: Is anyone here with this child?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps they are not in this area."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Shall we move around a bit?
Someone might be searching for this child in another area—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"...Mama's not here...?
Will I really never get to see her again...?"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I don't... I don't want that...! 
Uuu, uuuuuh...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
I'm sure we'll meet again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smiling gently, Victoire Pisa took the hat in hand and placed it on the lost child's head.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My treasure... is a magic hat
that connects me to someone dear to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually... this hat has the exact same design
as the one I've worn since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Because thanks to this hat...
I was found by my precious person, too."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...You know,
back when I was around your age, too—"

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh...
Where is everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: (What should I do... If this keeps up, I won't be able to see everyone anymore...!)

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
—Pisa-chan!
I finally found you...!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, what a relief...!!
You know what, that hat!!
Thanks to that, I was able to spot you!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text: A big, white, adorable hat! You always wear it, don't you, Pisa-chan?

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see.
So that's how it was...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Like a beacon, like a guiding light.
It shows the way. We will surely connect once more.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: This hat... makes me believe so.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There, with that hat, you're safe.
Be brave and—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go look for your mother together.
...Okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Yeah, thank you, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Shortly thereafter,
the child was safely reunited with their mother.

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: I really don't know how to thank you... To think you stayed by her side this entire time...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it.
I'm just so glad the two of you could reunite.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks!
...Oh right, I'll come cheer for you at your next race, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I know I'll find you right away!
That hat will be my landmark!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I look forward to the day we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I'll have to do my best in the next race, won't I?
choice_data_list: That hat was something truly precious to you, wasn't it?
That hat was really special to you, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes—very much so.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I decided a long time ago
that this hat would be a part of my racing silks...
choice_data_list: That hat must really be precious to you.
That hat must really be precious to you.
The ribbon on that hat kind of looks like wings, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I decided a long time ago
that this hat would be a part of my racing silks...
choice_data_list: That hat must really be precious to you.
That hat must really be precious to you.
The ribbon on that hat kind of looks like wings, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because to me, it's a symbol of 'being connected.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to connect everyone
who watches my races—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought it was the perfect outfit
to entrust with a wish like that."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Wings... Hehe, that might actually be true.
Especially the way it softly billows out when fluttering in the wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light wings fluttering at her back.
A pure white halo above her head.
Smiling like that, she looked just like—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, heheh.
...You're exaggerating, Trainer.
